title: Masking / Tokenization Decision v1
description: The externalized output of the masking Policy Decision Point (PDP), evaluated at read / export / activation / re-identification time. It records the policy verdict, the transforms applied per field, any governed re-identification (with mandatory reason-for-action), and a verifiable receipt. Unlike a passive masking rule, every decision is itself evidence: it carries a policy-decision ref and an optional BEACON_COMMIT custody receipt.

audience.description: Who is asking (role/profile). Re-identification gates on a profile attribute (OpenID Connect).

verdict.description: PDP outcome. allow_masked = returnable only through the applied transforms.

forbidden_mixture.description: Populated when the deny is a policy-polytope veto (e.g. health + adtech).

applied_transforms.description: Per-field transform actually applied for this audience/realm.

target_domain.description: For re_tokenize: destination domain reached via homomorphic tweak.

re_identification.description: Present only when requested_op = re_identify. Re-id is a governed, audited, reversible release.

reason_for_action.description: Mandatory free-text justification — recorded for audit.

release_pack_ref.description: HELL-ER release pack, if a bundle is emitted.

side_channel_mitigations.description: Active mitigations against the 4 re-identification risks.

receipt.description: Makes the decision itself verifiable evidence.

beacon_commit_receipt.description: TriTRPC BEACON_COMMIT receipt sealing this decision into the custody chain.
